bottleneck.description: Specialty foundry — RF SOI, high-voltage analog, BCD, SiGe. RF SOI capacity in particular is mission-critical for smartphone PA chips with multi-year qualification cycles.

dependency.key_customers: RF chip designers (Qorvo, Skyworks, Broadcom), power management ICs

editorial.notes: RF SOI capacity is structurally tight — Tower + GlobalFoundries are the merchant suppliers for smartphone PA chips. Failed Intel acquisition (2022-23) demonstrated the strategic value of this capacity. Multi-year process qualification creates real switching friction for fabless customers. Revised from MEDIUM on merchant-supplier oligopoly grounds.
